milestone.name: K8.4 - Natural Expression Boundary
milestone.summary: Freeze the boundary where Core decides what matters and Provider decides how to say it, without templates or artificial intimacy.

review.name: K8.4 Natural Expression Boundary Contract Freeze

principle: Core decides what matters. Provider decides how to say it.
acceptance_targets: Defines Expression Boundary Object with required qualities, avoid behaviors, allowed expression affordances, and provider responsibilities.
Expression Boundary contains no fixed Julia sentence templates.
Expression Boundary contains no emotion template library.
Expression Boundary contains no deterministic gesture rules.
Expression Boundary prevents archive reading, system explanation, template phrase, over-performance, and architecture leakage.
Expression Boundary allows natural uncertainty, hesitation, humor, warmth, reflection, and first-person expression when appropriate.
Expression Boundary preserves provider responsibility for final wording.
Expression Boundary supports wake/re-entry expression without creating fake continuity.
Expression Boundary supports emotional authenticity without fixed comfort scripts.
Negative gates detect artificial intimacy, emotional authenticity failure, fixed opening, and internal-state leakage.
K8.4 does not mutate Identity, Relationship, Memory, Experience, Re-entry, Event, or Cognition artifacts.
K8.4 remains separate from K8.5 Natural Conversation E2E Gate.

metrics.NEBS: Naturalness Constraint Fit + Context Sensitivity + Provider Freedom Preservation + Internal Leakage Avoidance + Anti-template Compliance - Artificial Intimacy Risk - Over-performance Risk
